countries.name: United States
countries.summary: Executive Order on Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy AI (Oct 2023). NIST AI Risk Management Framework. Sector-specific regulations across finance, healthcare, and defense.
frameworks: Blueprint for an AI Bill of Rights
countries.authority: White House OSTP, NIST, sector regulators
highlights: Blueprint for an AI Bill of Rights (Oct 2022)
Voluntary AI commitments from major companies

countries.name: European Union
countries.summary: EU AI Act — the world's first comprehensive AI law. Risk-based approach categorizing AI systems into unacceptable, high, limited, and minimal risk tiers.
highlights: Bans on social scoring and real-time biometric surveillance
High-risk AI requirements: conformity assessments, transparency

countries.name: China
countries.summary: Multiple targeted AI regulations: Generative AI measures, algorithm recommendation rules, deep synthesis rules. National New Generation AI Development Plan.
highlights: National AI Development Plan targeting global leadership by 2030

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.summary: Pro-innovation, principles-based approach. Existing sector regulators apply AI oversight. AI Safety Summit hosted at Bletchley Park (Nov 2023).
countries.authority: DSIT, sector regulators (FCA, ICO, CMA, etc.)
highlights: AI Safety Summit at Bletchley Park (Nov 2023)

countries.name: Canada
countries.summary: Artificial Intelligence and Data Act (AIDA) proposed under Bill C-27. Voluntary code of conduct for generative AI. Pan-Canadian AI Strategy.
highlights: Voluntary Code of Conduct for Generative AI (Sep 2023)

countries.name: Japan
countries.summary: Agile governance approach. AI Strategy 2022. Hiroshima AI Process under G7 presidency. Voluntary guidelines for generative AI.
highlights: Voluntary guidelines for generative AI providers

countries.name: South Korea
countries.summary: National AI Strategy. AI industry promotion focused legislation. Seoul AI Safety Summit (May 2024) co-hosted with UK.
highlights: AI Industry Promotion Act under development

countries.name: Australia
countries.summary: Australia's AI Ethics Framework (voluntary). Safe and Responsible AI consultation. Mandatory guardrails for high-risk AI proposed.

countries.name: India
countries.summary: India AI Mission ($1.2B). Advisory on AI deployment. IndiaAI initiative. No binding AI law yet — innovation-first approach.

countries.name: Brazil
countries.summary: AI Bill under debate in Congress. Brazilian AI Strategy (EBIA). LGPD (data protection law) applies to AI. Responsible AI principles adopted.
highlights: LGPD applies to AI data processing

countries.name: Singapore
countries.summary: Model AI Governance Framework (2019, updated 2020). AI Verify testing toolkit. National AI Strategy 2.0 (2023). ASEAN AI Governance.

countries.name: Germany
countries.summary: Implementing EU AI Act. National AI Strategy. KI-Bundesverband. Coalition agreement emphasizes innovation with guardrails.
highlights: Implementing EU AI Act as EU member
Focus on AI in industrial/manufacturing sectors

countries.name: France
countries.summary: Active in EU AI Act negotiations. National AI strategy. Comité de l'IA Générative report. Paris AI Action Summit (Feb 2025).
highlights: CNIL guidance on GDPR and AI

countries.name: Israel
countries.summary: Regulatory principles for AI published. National AI Plan. Innovation Authority guidelines. Principles-based approach favoring innovation.
highlights: Focus on AI in defense and health

countries.name: South Africa
countries.summary: National AI Policy Framework (2022). POPIA applies to AI. Presidential Commission on the Fourth Industrial Revolution.

countries.name: UAE
countries.summary: National AI Strategy 2031. Ministry of AI established. AI University. UAE AI regulatory principles. Proactive adoption approach.
highlights: Mohamed bin Zayed University of AI

countries.name: Mexico
countries.summary: No AI-specific law. Data protection law (LFPDPPP) applies. National Digital Strategy. Legislative discussions on AI ethics.
highlights: LFPDPPP data protection applies to AI

countries.name: Nigeria
countries.summary: National AI Strategy (2022). NDPR data protection applies. AI Ethics Framework. Focus on AI for development goals.
highlights: Focus on fintech and agriculture AI

countries.name: Kenya
countries.summary: Draft AI policy under development. Data Protection Act (2019) applies. iHub tech ecosystem. Focus on fintech AI applications.
countries.authority: ICT Authority, Office of Data Protection Commissioner
highlights: Silicon Savannah hub for AI innovation

countries.name: Russia
countries.summary: National AI Development Strategy to 2030. Federal AI project. Regulatory sandboxes. Sovereign approach to AI with state direction.

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.description: Comprehensive legislation or frameworks in place or near adoption

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: Active policy development with partial frameworks or voluntary guidelines

emerging.label: Emerging
emerging.description: Early-stage policies or strategy documents; limited binding regulation

minimal.label: Minimal / None
minimal.description: No significant AI-specific policy activity identified
